results.note: Appendix documentorum (PL 142). Searched extensively for English translations of this appendix of documents; no published English translation found in CCEL, ANF, NPNF, or scholarly databases.
Praecepta (PL 142). Brief precepts/rules work. No English translation located despite searches for monastic rule fragments or precept collections in translation.

Historia mortis et miraculorum Leonis IX (PL 143). Medieval account of Pope Leo IX's death and miracles. Searched specifically for English translations; none found. Leo IX's works are in NPNF but this specific text appears untranslated.

Epistolae additae (PL 144). Additional letters, possibly supplementary Peter Damian correspondence. While some Peter Damian letters are translated in the Fathers of the Church series, these specific additional epistles do not appear to have a published English translation.
Corollaria de B. Petro Damiano (PL 145). Corollaries/supplementary material on Peter Damian. No English translation located despite searches in medieval and patristic translation databases.

Acta pontificalia (PL 148). Papal acts/records. Searched for English translations of papal documentary materials; collections of papal documents do not appear to include complete translations of these specific acta.

Epistolae ad Gregorium VII (PL 148). Letters to Pope Gregory VII. While Gregory VII's own letters are translated (Ephraim Emerton, Columbia 1932; H.E.J. Cowdrey), letters TO him from various correspondents do not appear systematically translated.
Epistola ad P. Papae nepotem (PL 151). Single letter to a pope's nephew. No English translation located for this brief (704 words) epistolary fragment.
Epistolae ad Urbanum (PL 151). Letters to Pope Urban II. No comprehensive English translation of this letter collection found despite searches for papal correspondence translations.
Libellus supplex ad Patres in concilio anno 1050 (PL 151). Petition to Church Fathers at 1050 council. Searched for this specific conciliar petition; no English translation located.

Rhythmi veteres (PL 151). Ancient medieval Latin verses (15,938 words). Searched for English translations of medieval rhythmic poetry collections; this specific text does not appear to have a published English translation.

Tituli funebres (PL 152). Funeral inscriptions/epitaphs. Medieval funeral title texts. Searched for English translations of medieval epigraphic collections; this collection does not appear to be translated.

Probationes (PL 153, 185). Specimen texts or proofs (39,960 words across two volumes). Probationes in medieval manuscripts refer to pen trials/testing; no systematic English translation of this collection located.

Statuta antiqua ordinis Carthusiani (PL 153). Ancient Carthusian order statutes (1258, approved 1271). While Carthusian rule traditions are discussed in scholarly works, this specific statute collection does not appear to have a complete published English translation.

Ex inventione et miraculis S. Mathiae (PL 154). On discovery/invention and miracles of Saint Matthias. Related to Lambert of Liège's hagiographic work but no English translation of this specific collection located.

Gesta Alberonis archiepiscopi (PL 154). English translation: 'A Warrior Bishop of the Twelfth Century: The Deeds of Albero of Trier' translated by Brian A. Pavlac, Pontifical Institute of Mediaeval Studies (Toronto, 2008).
De rebus gestis B. Idae (PL 155). On the deeds of Blessed Ida. Searches for Saint Ida hagiography and deeds do not locate a complete English translation of this specific text.
Epistolae ad Ludovicum Francorum (PL 155). Letters to King Louis of France. No English translation of this specific epistolary collection located.
Testimonia de Guiberto (PL 156). Testimonies about Guibert (possibly Guibert of Nogent). No English translation of this testimony collection located despite searches for Guibert materials.
Epistolae ad Calixtum (PL 163). Letters to Pope Callixtus II. No comprehensive English translation of this papal correspondence collection located.

Miracula S. Jacobi (PL 163). This work (miracles of Saint James) corresponds to Book II of the Liber Sancti Jacobi, which is translated as 'Miracles of Saint James: Translations from the Liber Sancti Jacobi' by Linda Davidson, Thomas F. Coffey, and Maryjane Dunn, Italica Press (Medieval and Renaissance Texts series).

Continuationes Cosmae (PL 166). Continuations of Cosmas of Prague's Chronicle. While Cosmas's original Chronicle has English translation (ed. Bak, Rady, etc., Central European Medieval Texts), whether the Continuationes by other hands are included/translated separately is unclear from available sources.
Epistolae ad Honorium (PL 166). Letters to Pope Honorius II. No English translation of this papal correspondence collection located.
Piae donationes (PL 166). Pious donations/charitable gifts records. No English translation of this documentary collection located.
Chartae (PL 170). Medieval charters. This brief (350 words) charter fragment does not appear to have an English translation.
Annales Bambergenses (PL 173). Annals/chronicles of Bamberg. Searched for English translations of Bamberg chronicles; no published translation located.
Codex diplomaticus (PL 174). Diplomatic code/charter collection. Medieval charter compilations of this type do not appear to have comprehensive English translations.
Privilegia (PL 178). Privileges/charters (198 words). This brief documentary fragment does not appear to have an English translation.
Concilium Remense (PL 179). Council of Reims. No English translation of this council's acta located.
Epistolae III (PL 179). Third collection of epistles. No English translation of this letter collection located.
Epistolae ad Innocentium (PL 179). Letters to Pope Innocent. No comprehensive English translation of this correspondence collection located.
Epistolae ad Lucium papam (PL 179). Letters to Pope Lucius. No English translation of this papal correspondence collection located.

Canonizatio S. Bernardi (PL 185). Canonization proceedings/record of Saint Bernard of Clairvaux. While Bernard's own works are extensively translated, his canonization documents do not appear to be published in English translation.
Epitaphia (PL 185). Epitaphs (512 words). Medieval epitaph collection with no English translation located.
Liber VI (PL 185). Sixth book of an unnamed work. Limited information about this fragment; no English translation located.
Miscellanea (PL 185). Miscellaneous collection (4,299 words). This unspecified miscellaneous collection does not appear to have an English translation.
Epistolae ad Adrianum IV (PL 188). Letters to Pope Adrian IV. No comprehensive English translation of this papal correspondence collection located.
Diplomata et chartae (PL 189). Diplomas and charters. Medieval charter collections of this type do not appear to have comprehensive English translations.
Privilegia concessa tempore Petri Cluniacensis (PL 189). Privileges granted during Peter of Cluny's time. No English translation of this documentary collection located.
Documenta historica (PL 190). Historical documents (23,582 words). Searched extensively; this large documentary collection does not appear to have a published English translation.
Epistolae de venerabili sacramento Eucharistae (PL 194). Letters concerning the venerable Eucharist. No English translation of this doctrinal correspondence collection located.
Epistolae (PL 202). Untitled epistles (1 word in manifest, likely metadata error). Insufficient information to assess translation status; no English translation located.
Epistolae ad Coelestinum III (PL 206). Letters to Pope Celestine III. No comprehensive English translation of this papal correspondence collection located.
Diplomata (PL 209). Diplomatic documents/charters (3,674 words). Medieval diploma collections do not appear to have published English translations.
Carmina (PL 210). Medieval Latin poems/verses (874 words). No English translation of this verse collection located.
